notes.title: Ver 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash".
We have released a (free) update containing the following items.
This update corresponds to the versions stated below.

[h3]■Improved Functions/Bug Fixes
▼Improved Functions[/h3]
- Improved upon the performance issues that ocurred under specific conditions.
- Fixed the issue causing an error to appear while searching for players at the Online Lobby on the PlayStation® edition.
- Fixed the issue causing an error to appear  during the matchmaking for the online battles on the PlayStation® edition.
- Adjusted the algorhytm on the PlayStation® edition to make it easier to find players within the same region during the matchmaking.

[h3]▼Bug Fixes[/h3]
✔️ Fixed the bug that caused the game to crash under specific conditions on the Xbox edition.
✔️ Fixed the bug causing the game to freeze at the battle results screen under specific conditions during online matches.
✔️ Fixed the bug that caused the game to freeze under specific conditions during online matches when executing Joint Attacks and Awakened Moves.
✔️ Fixed the bug that caused unexpected behaviors under specific conditions after choosing to Rematch in online battles. 
✔️ Fixed the bug that caused the game to freeze under specific conditions when a character was blown away.
✔️ Fixed other minor bugs.

[h3]■Additional Contents[/h3]
Distributed the following 4 items.
・Title: "Jujutsu High - New Student"
・Nicknames: "Jujutsu Kaisen" & "Cursed Clash"
・Emblem: "Jujutsu High"
・Plate: "Special Plate- Main Visual"

*An internet connection is required to install these updates.
*The latest update must be installed in order to access the game's online contents.
*The battle replay data is not compatible with the previous version of the game.

Please note that it will not be possible to reproduce any replay data from the previous game version after this update.

You can follow these steps to record your gameplay on Steam.
▼Steam
・Press the “Windows Key”＋”G” to access the “Game Bar” → Head to the “Capture” menu and click the “Record” button.
　*You can execute multiple commands from here. Depending on the OS version, you may also be able to choose this option directly from the “Settings” menu.
　*This option allows you to capture a video of your current gameplay.

We hope you continue to enjoy "Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash".

notes.content:
[h1]You've got questions, we've got answers! Find out everything you need to know about Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash here:[/h1]

[h2]Synopsis[/h2]

[h3]Itadori Yuji is a boy with tremendous physical strength, though he lives a completely ordinary high school life. One day, to save a classmate who has been attacked by Curses, he eats the finger of the King of Curses, taking the Curse into his own soul.

From then on, he shares one body with it. Guided by the most powerful of sorcerers, Gojo Satoru, Itadori is admitted to the Tokyo High School of Sorcery, an organization that fights the Curses… and thus begins the heroic tale of a boy who became a Curse to exorcise a Curse, a life from which he could never turn back.[/h3]

notes.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Clash will launch on February 2, 2024!
notes.content:
[h3]In [b]JUJUTSU KAISEN CURSED CLASH[/b], players will be able to [b]select their own 2v2 teams[/b], each capable of executing a [b]wide array of powerful tag-team attacks and combos[/b]. Different [b]character combinations will have unique synergies and power dynamics[/b].[/h3]

[previewyoutube=_gRW7yQzRKI;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]JUJUTSU KAISEN CURSED CLASH[/b] will bring a [b]story mode based on season 1 of the anime[/b] and [b]Jujutsu Kaisen 0[/b], allowing players to [b]face strong enemies[/b]. 

In order to [i]test out their many cursed skills with or against friends[/i], an [b]online co-op and competition mode will also be available[/b] at launch, allowing [b]players to team up online[/b] and also [b]face other opponents worldwide in ranked or casual battles[/b].

To showcase their battling techniques in style, a [b]wide array of costumes for playable characters[/b] can be unlocked, through playing the game or upcoming DLCs, along with [b]face cards to update their online profile with[/b]!

[h2][b]Pre-order now![/b][/h2]
